import PV_L2C_M31
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_PackedMasks

def insert (s : BitVec 16) (p : Fin 16) : BitVec 16 := s ||| ((BitVec.ofNat 16 1) <<< p.val)

theorem inserted_bit (s : BitVec 16) (p q : Fin 16) :
    (insert s p).getLsbD q.val=(s.getLsbD q.val || decide (p=q)) := by
  unfold insert
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_or,BitVec.getLsbD_shiftLeft,BitVec.getLsbD_one]
  simp only [q.isLt,decide_true,Bool.true_and]
  congr 1
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true,Bool.not_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq,decide_eq_false_iff_not,Fin.ext_iff]
  omega
#print axioms inserted_bit

abbrev Masks := Fin 64 → BitVec 16

def block (p : Fin 1024) : Fin 64 := ⟨p.val/16,by have := p.isLt;omega⟩
def bit (p : Fin 1024) : Fin 16 := ⟨p.val%16,by omega⟩
def contains (m : Masks) (q : Fin 1024) : Bool := (m (block q)).getLsbD (bit q).val

def put (m : Masks) (p : Fin 1024) : Masks :=
  fun b => if b=block p then insert (m b) (bit p) else m b

theorem put_contains (m : Masks) (p q : Fin 1024) :
    contains (put m p) q=(contains m q || decide (p=q)) := by
  by_cases hb : block q=block p
  · simp only [contains,put,hb,if_pos,inserted_bit]
    have he : (bit p=bit q)↔p=q := by
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val hb
      simp only [block] at hv
      simp only [bit,Fin.ext_iff]
      omega
    simp only [he]
  · have hpq : p≠q := by intro h;subst p;exact hb rfl
    simp only [contains,put,hb,if_false,hpq,decide_false,Bool.or_false]
#print axioms put_contains

def pack (rows : List (Fin 1024)) (m : Masks) : Masks := rows.foldl put m

theorem packed_contains (rows : List (Fin 1024)) (m : Masks) (q : Fin 1024) :
    contains (pack rows m) q=(contains m q || decide (q∈rows)) := by
  induction rows generalizing m with
  | nil => simp only [pack,List.foldl_nil,List.not_mem_nil,decide_false,Bool.or_false]
  | cons p rows ih =>
    change contains (pack rows (put m p)) q=_
    rw [ih,put_contains]
    simp [List.mem_cons,eq_comm,Bool.or_assoc]
#print axioms packed_contains
end PV_L2C_PackedMasks

import PV_L2C_ExtractedRows
import PV_L2C_VecWrite
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_OwnedBalance
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_QBalance PV_L2C_ReferenceQ PV_L2C_ExtractedRows PV_L2C_VecRead
open R1Z.ProverCommitBalanceRecursion

def rows : List Usize := rowSequence 1024 0#usize

theorem rows_bounded : ∀ r∈rows,r.val<1024 := by
  intro r hr
  have hm : r.val∈rows.map (fun r => r.val) := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨r,hr,rfl⟩
  rw [rows,sequence_ascending 1024 0#usize (by decide)] at hm
  have hb := List.mem_range'.mp hm
  have hz : (0#usize).val=0 := by scalar_tac
  rw [hz] at hb
  omega
#print axioms rows_bounded

def output (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Usize) : Fin 1024 → Q :=
  fun i => if i.val=d.val then subQ zero (foldQ (selected table active d rows) zero) else table i

theorem complete_result (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool)
    (d : Usize) (hd : d.val<1024) (ha : active ⟨d.val,hd⟩=false) :
    prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_owned
      (vector bound1024 (fun i => source (table i))) d (PV_L2C_VecRead.active active)=
      ok (.Ok (),vector bound1024 (fun i => source (output table active d i))) := by
  have hlen : alloc.vec.Vec.len (vector bound1024 (fun i => source (table i)))=1024#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    change (List.ofFn (fun i => source (table i))).length=1024
    exact List.length_ofFn
  have hd' : d.val<(1024#usize).val := by scalar_tac
  rw [qm31_owned_fold,hlen]
  simp only [bne_self_eq_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  rw [read_active (n:=1024#usize) active d hd']
  simp only [ha,bind_tc_ok,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  rw [← source_zero,fold_source table active d rows rows_bounded zero]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,sub_source]
  rw [PV_L2C_VecWrite.index_mut bound1024 _ d hd]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [PV_L2C_VecWrite.write bound1024 _ d hd]
  have he : (fun i : Fin 1024 => if i.val=d.val then
      source (subQ zero (foldQ (selected table active d rows) zero)) else source (table i))=
      (fun i => source (output table active d i)) := by
    funext i
    unfold output
    split <;> rfl
  rw [he]
#print axioms complete_result
end PV_L2C_OwnedBalance

import PV_L2C_OwnedBalance
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_RowEnumeration
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result PV_L2C_VecRead
open R1Z.ProverCommitBalanceRecursion PV_L2C_OwnedBalance

def index (i : Fin 1024) : Usize := Usize.ofNatCore i.val (by have := i.isLt; have := bound1024; omega)

theorem index_val (i : Fin 1024) : (index i).val=i.val := by rfl
#print axioms index_val

/-- Symbolic range equality, without normalizing the 1024-cell recurrence. -/
theorem enumeration : rows=List.ofFn index := by
  apply (List.map_inj_right (f:=fun r : Usize => r.val)
    (fun a b h => UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h)).mp
  rw [rows,sequence_ascending 1024 0#usize (by decide),List.map_ofFn]
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_range',List.length_ofFn]
  · intro i hi hj
    have hz : (0#usize).val=0 := by scalar_tac
    simp only [List.getElem_range',List.getElem_ofFn,Function.comp_apply,index_val,hz,
      Nat.mul_one,Nat.one_mul,Nat.zero_add]
#print axioms enumeration
end PV_L2C_RowEnumeration

import PV_L2C_RowEnumeration
import PV_L2C_PaddingNative
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_SelectedDense
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_QBalance PV_L2C_QFold PV_L2C_PaddingNative
open PV_L2C_ExtractedRows PV_L2C_OwnedBalance PV_L2C_RowEnumeration

theorem filtered_dense {I : Type} (rows : List I) (sel : I → Bool) (value : I → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i∈rows,Canonical (value i)) (s : Q) (hs : Canonical s) :
    foldQ (rows.filterMap (fun i => if sel i then some (value i) else none)) s=
      foldQ (rows.map (fun i => if sel i then value i else zero)) s := by
  induction rows generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i is ih =>
    have ht : ∀ j∈is,Canonical (value j) := fun j hj => hc j (by simp [hj])
    cases h : sel i with
    | false =>
      simp only [List.filterMap_cons,List.map_cons,h,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,foldQ,
        native_add_zero s hs]
      exact ih ht s hs
    | true =>
      simp only [List.filterMap_cons,List.map_cons,h,if_true,foldQ]
      exact ih ht _ (add_canonical s (value i) hs (hc i (by simp)))
#print axioms filtered_dense

theorem index_injective : Function.Injective index := by
  intro i j h
  apply Fin.ext
  have he := congrArg UScalar.val h
  simpa only [index_val] using he
#print axioms index_injective

/-- Exactly the excluded finite sum, with the extracted traversal order. -/
theorem selected_sum (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Fin 1024)
    (hc : ∀ i,Canonical (table i)) :
    foldQ (selected table active (index d) rows) zero=excluded active d table := by
  unfold selected
  rw [filtered_dense rows _ _ (by
    intro r hr
    have hb := rows_bounded r hr
    simp only [lookup,dif_pos hb]
    exact hc _) zero zero_canonical,enumeration,List.map_ofFn]
  change foldQ (List.ofFn (fun i =>
    if (!flag active (index i)) && (index i != index d) then lookup table (index i) else zero)) zero=
      foldQ (List.ofFn (inactiveTable active (without d table))) zero
  apply congrArg (fun values : List Q => foldQ values zero)
  apply congrArg (fun f : Fin 1024 → Q => List.ofFn f)
  funext i
  have hb : (index i).val<1024 := by rw [index_val];exact i.isLt
  have he : (index i=index d)↔i=d := index_injective.eq_iff
  have hf : flag active (index i)=active i := by
    unfold flag
    rw [dif_pos hb]
    rfl
  have hl : lookup table (index i)=table i := by
    unfold lookup
    rw [dif_pos hb]
    rfl
  rw [hf,hl]
  by_cases hid : i=d <;> cases ha : active i <;>
    simp [inactiveTable,without,hid,ha,he]
#print axioms selected_sum

/-- The complete extracted caller's output is the negative-sum store model. -/
theorem output_eq (table : Fin 1024 → Q) (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Fin 1024)
    (hc : ∀ i,Canonical (table i)) :
    output table active (index d)=rebalance active d table := by
  funext i
  unfold output rebalance
  rw [selected_sum table active d hc,index_val]
  have he : (i.val=d.val)↔i=d := Fin.ext_iff.symm
  rw [he]
#print axioms output_eq
end PV_L2C_SelectedDense

import PV_L2C_SelectedDense
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_ExtractedGuard
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_PaddingNative PV_L2C_QFold PV_L2C_ReferenceQ
open PV_L2C_VecRead PV_L2C_RowEnumeration PV_L2C_SelectedDense

/-- Complete extracted owned balance result and the two raw table predicates.
The supplied table is the sampler shape on arbitrary canonical random values;
this theorem does not assume either rejection predicate is false. -/
theorem padding_result (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (d : Fin 1024) (random : Fin 1024 → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i,Canonical (random i)) (hd : active d=false) :
    prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_owned
      (vector bound1024 (fun i => source (sample active d random i))) (index d)
      (PV_L2C_VecRead.active active)=
        ok (.Ok (),vector bound1024 (fun i => source (rebalance active d (sample active d random) i))) ∧
    (∀ i,(active i && decide (rebalance active d (sample active d random) i≠zero))=false) ∧
    decide (tableSum (inactiveTable active (rebalance active d (sample active d random)))≠zero)=false := by
  have hb : (index d).val<1024 := by rw [index_val];exact d.isLt
  have ha : active ⟨(index d).val,hb⟩=false := by simpa only [index_val] using hd
  refine ⟨?_,guard_outcomes active d random hc hd⟩
  rw [PV_L2C_OwnedBalance.complete_result _ active (index d) hb ha,
    output_eq _ active d (sample_canonical active d random hc)]
#print axioms padding_result
end PV_L2C_ExtractedGuard
